name: rss_feed_reader
description: Fetch and parse RSS 2.0 and Atom feeds, returning structured article entries with title, link, summary, author, and publication timestamp.

feed_url.description: URL of the RSS 2.0 or Atom feed

limit.description: Maximum number of feed items to return (default: 5)

returns.description: Parsed feed metadata containing channel title, description, article items, item count, and status
